the learning challenges of engineering international students in a Malaysian technical higher education institution are related to their transition from their home countries’ education background.
international students are facing difficulties in their learning experience when following a Malaysian technical and higher education institution’s curriculum.

international students are facing challenges in their learning experiences when following a curriculum that emphasizes on the practical approach in the Malaysian technical and vocational higher education institution.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how academic staff perceive the learning transition challenges of international students in a TVE institution.
the learning experiences of international students in Malaysia and how they can be supported by academic staff to achieve the expected learning outcomes.
the challenges of international students learning in a technical and vocational (TVET) institution, and how the academic staff teaching them are responding.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the international students’ learning experiences in Malaysia TVE institutions are not only affected by the curriculum but also their education background.
the transition of students from the education background to the learning environment of the TVE institutions is a challenge.
international students’ transition into Malaysian higher education institution, in general, and in the technical and engineering education, in particular, is a challenge for them.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
there is a need to develop a more holistic curriculum that can accommodate the learning challenges of these students.
the international students are facing a transition challenge from their home country education system to the Malaysian education system.
the international student’s transition into a new learning environment is challenging.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the transition from theory to practice learning approach in a TVE institution is challenging for international students, particularly those with different education backgrounds.
the transition from the students’ previous education system to the new one is a significant factor in their learning experiences.

international students need to be aware of the learning challenges in a TVE higher education institution, and academic staff need to be more aware of the students’ background in order to facilitate their learning process.
